environment.scope: Default study package environment only. Per-configuration declared_environment and toolchain commands override native-toolkit defaults; verify per-run snapshots before release comparisons.

implementation_ontology.actual_algorithm: Factor-two nearest-neighbor BCHW tensor replication; backward transpose sums each2x2 output-gradient tile. Four actual source kernels: scalar-flat and two-dimensional two-component accesses in each direction.
implementation_ontology.work_item_mapping: All six scalar block sizes and three squared2D block sizes from native source are retained, including allbatch/channel planes and exact tail guards.
implementation_ontology.resource_policy: Zero shared bytes, no block synchronization.

reference_repair.finding: Historical CUDA.jl genuinely implements all four source upsample kernels with corresponding block geometries. It already scalarizes native float2 stores/loads in the second mappings. Study preserves these four kernel bodies and adds identical named inputs, context-wide five-trial measurement, and full-output independent validation. Native and historical validators check only B*C*(H/2)*(W/2) forward elements instead of4*B*C*H*W, a checker blind spot rather than an observed device-kernel defect.
reference_repair.signed_zero_scope: Native backward1 starts accumulator+0 before first add; direct four-term CUDAjl expression omits initial+0. Measured fixtures contain no negative zero and are exactly equal. No general signed-zero-bit fidelity claim.

host_oracle_precision: Julia exact Float32 dyadic CPU mapping

native_to_julia_mapping.reason: All four source work mappings and all18launch geometries retained. Existing CUDA.jl and portable variants use four ordered scalar accesses in place of native float2 access syntax; actual generated vectorization unprofiled.
